text.body:
traiguṇyāḍhyaśikhīndubhāskarakarapradyotanodgīthajaiḥ agryaiḥ padmajakañjadṛktrinayanairadhyāsitaiḥ śaktibhiḥ| 1ab saṃrodhasthitisambhavātmarataye bhinnastridhaiko 'pi yaḥ tasmai nityacite śivāya vibhave rājño 'rthasiddhyai namaḥ|| 1cd
rūpaṃ yasya navendumaṇḍitaśikhaṃ trayyāḥ pratītaṃ paraṃ bījaṃ brahmaharīśvarodayakaraṃ bhinnaṃ kalābhistridhā| 2ab sākṣādakṣaramāmananti munayo yogādhigamyaṃ namaḥ saṃsiddhyai praṇavātmane bhagavate tasmai śivāyāstu vaḥ|| 2cd
ekā prākkalahaṃsavibhramagatiḥ kāntonmanā yā satī bhittvāṅgaṃ gaganodgatātmarataye yātā navatvaṃ punaḥ| 3ab padmaṃ mānasasambhṛtaṃ nijaruciprojjṛmbhitaṃ bibhratī sā śaktiḥ śivasaṃgatodayakarī gaurī parā pātu vaḥ|| 3cd
yenaitāni jaganti yajvahutabhugbhāsvannabhasvannabhaḥkṣityambhaḥkṣaṇadākaraiḥ svatanubhirvyātanvataivāṣṭabhiḥ| 4ab uccaiḥ kāraṇaśaktirapratihatā vyākhyāyate 'nakṣaraṃ jīyātkāraṇakāraṇaṃ sa bhagavānardhenducūḍāmaṇiḥ|| 4cd
nārāyaṇaṃ namata yo vibhutāṃ vitanvan lokatrayaṃ tripadalaṅghitamātrameva| 5ab dṛṣṭvā turīyapadamāptumivādhunāpi nidrācchalena vidadhāti samādhimabdhau|| 5cd
ambhojabhūrjayati yo vadanaiścaturbhiroṃkāravāridaravaṃ samamujjagāra| 6ab kṣetrāhitaṃ tribhuvanodayapūraṇārthamutsūnatāmiva nayannijabījamādyam|| 6cd
mandāṃśumaṇḍalavinirgatavāridhārā mandākinī jayati dhūrjaṭinā dhṛtā yā| 7ab mūrdhnā nagendratanayārdhaśarīrasaṃdheḥ premānubandhamiva darśayituṃ prakṛṣṭam|| 7cd
āsīdā nīrarāśeravanipatiśiroratnamālārcitāṅghriḥ bālādityābhidhāno 'pyarikulakamalopaplavākhaṇḍacandraḥ| 8ab somākauṇḍinyavaṃśāmbaratalatilako bhūpatirbhūrikīrtiḥ dordaṇḍoddyotitāninditapurabharitaṃ rājyalakṣmīṃ vahanyaḥ|| 8cd
proddṛptadviṣatāṃ dadhadyudhi vadhūvaidhavyadīkṣāvidhiṃ badhnanyaḥ śiśirāṃśuraśmiviśadāṃ satkīrtimālāṃ guṇaiḥ| 9ab svargadvārapure purandarapurapraspardhisaṃvardhane sārvaḥ śārvamatiṣṭhipatsavibhavaṃ liṅgaṃ vidhānānvitam|| 9cd
brahmakṣatraparamparodayakarī tadbhāgineyī satī puṇyaṃ nāma sarasvatīti dadhatī khyātā jagatpāvanī| 10ab nānāmnāyagirāṃ gabhīramadhikaṃ pātraṃ dvijānāṃ varaṃ sindhūnāmiva sindhurājamagamadyā viśvarūpaṃ priyam|| 10cd
somādye sārabhūte nijakulanivahe bhūridhāmni vyatīte rudropendrāmarendraprabhṛtisuravaraiḥ saṃgate nandanārtham| 11ab tadvaṃśakṣīrasindhoḥ pravikasitayaśaḥpārijātābhijātā lebhe janmāvadātā bhuvanahitakarī yā dvitīyeva lakṣmīḥ|| 11cd
yā nāmnāpi mahendradevyabhihitā bhūbhṛtsutaiveśvarī devī divyavilāsinībhirasakṛtsaṃgīyamānastutiḥ| 12ab bhāsvadvaṃśasamudgato bhavapurādhīśāvanīśātmajaḥ yāṃ samprāpya mahendravarmanṛpatiḥ sārthāmadhādīśatām|| 12cd
lakṣmīṃ tīkṣṇetarāṃśoradhikamadharayandhvastadoṣāndhakāraḥ badhnanpadmānubandhaṃ prakaṭitatapasā tena patyā prajānām| 13ab devyāṃ tasyāmadityāṃ divasakara ivotpāditaḥ kaśyapena śrīmadrājendravarmāvanipatirabhavattejasāmākaro yaḥ|| 13cd
dugdhāmburāśeriva pūrṇacandraścaṇḍāṃśuratnādiva citrabhānuḥ| 14ab śuddhānvayādyo nitarāṃ viśuddhaḥ prādurbabhūvākhilabhūpavandyaḥ|| 14cd
tejaḥprakāśastamasāṃ vināśo diśāṃ prasādaḥ sphuṭatā kalānām| 15ab yattigmatejastuhināṃśukṛtyaṃ yenodaye tannikhilaṃ vitene|| 15cd
ramyo 'pi samyakprasavena somyaḥ santānakaḥ santatamudgatena| 16ab mahāphalaṃ yaṃ samavāpya bhūmnā ruroha koṭiṃ ramaṇīyatāyāḥ|| 16cd
vivardhamāno 'nvahamiddhakāntirvapurviśeṣeṇa manohareṇa| 17ab yaḥ sarvapakṣodayamādadhānastiraścakāraiva himāṃśulakṣmīm|| 17cd
yaḥ śaiśave 'pyāśu tathā kalābhiḥ pūrṇo 'nvahaṃ śabdaguṇe 'tidīptaḥ| 18ab yathā kalāvattvamapīndulabdhaṃ jāḍyānvitaṃ dūramadhaścakāra|| 18cd
nirasya doṣāvasaraṃ sphurantī prakāśitārthā bhuvane 'śnuvānā| 19ab vidyānavadyena mukhena yasya prāksaṃgatainīvadinasya dīptiḥ|| 19cd
āsādya śaktiṃ vibudhopanītāṃ māheśvarīṃ jñānamayīmamoghām| 20ab kumārabhāve vijitārivargo yo dīpayāmāsa mahendralakṣmīm|| 20cd
pṛthupratītaṃ prathitaṃ guṇaughaiḥ sadvaṃśajātaṃ prathane pradhānam| 21ab dhanurmahatkṣatrakulaṃ ca tulyaṃ yaḥ śikṣayā nāmayati sma tuṅgam|| 21cd
śiṣṭopadiṣṭaṃ pratipadya sadyaḥ kṣetraṃ yamutkṛṣṭamakṛṣṭapacyam| 22ab śraddhāmbhasā siktamarukṣaduccaiḥ śāstrasya cāstrasya ca bījamagryam|| 22cd
yaḥ sarvataḥ sarvaguṇānpaṭimnā ruceḥ sadādhāraviśeṣamujjhan| 23ab upādade lokahitāya bhāsvānrasāniva pratyahamastatandriḥ|| 23cd
udyānabhāgasya vasantasampadivāmṛtāṃśoriva paurṇamāsī| 24ab āpuṣṇatī yasya viśeṣaśobhāṃ samujjajṛmbhe navayauvanaśrīḥ|| 24cd
yatrāpi puṃso mahataḥ prakṛtyā nirūpitaṃ lakṣaṇamastaśeṣam| 25ab kenāpyasāṃkhyāgamavadvibhāvyaṃ prakāśayāmāsa maheśabhāvam|| 25cd
bālyātpravṛddhaṃ prabhṛtiprabhūtaṃ yadyasya saundaryamananyalabdham| 26ab dhruvaṃ vidhātāvayavīcakāra tadrañjayanyauvanakāntimṛddhām|| 26cd
nirugnamānaḥ satataṃ manobhūryasya sphuṭe nūtanayauvane 'pi| 27ab saundaryasaṃdarśanajātalajja ivāntikaṃ nopasasarpa darpāt|| 27cd
yasyāṅgalāvaṇyamananyarūḍhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ratiḥ premanimīlitākṣī| 28ab manye na mene patimātmanīnaṃ pinākinetrāgniśikhāvalīḍham|| 28cd
dhanurvikarṣapratatoruśaktiryuvapravīro yuvarājalakṣmīm| 29ab ayonijāṃ yo janakopanītāṃ sītāṃ satīṃ rāma ivoduvāha|| 29cd
yadārkabimbādiva hemakumbhādambhomṛtenāgalatābhiṣekaḥ| 30ab tataḥ prabhṛtyeva vivṛddhibhājā bhūtaṃ himāṃśoriva yasya lakṣmyā|| 30cd
santānāmbubhistīvramamantravandhyaistejonalo yasya samedhate sma| tatspardhayevāśrujalaiḥ patadbhirdviṣāṃ samaṃ śokahutāśano 'pi|| 31
alaṃkṛtenākṛtakaiḥ śrutādyairhṛdyairnijāṅgaiśca nisargakāntaiḥ| agrāmyabhūṣopacayena yena vibhūṣaṇaṃ maṅgalamityupāttam|| 32
navāṃ navāśyānamahābhiṣeko yo bhuktaratnābharaṇo babhāra| pītāmbhasaḥ kumbhabhavena lakṣmīmambhonidherudgataratnarāśeḥ|| 33
uccāvacairuccapadādhirūḍhairgrahairbhiyevākṛtavigraho 'pi| āropito yaḥ svayamapyakāṅkṣaḥ siṃhāsane hāṭakaśailatuṅge|| 34
yasyāṅgakānteḥ kva tathānavadyaṃ vidyeta manye 'pyupamānamanyat| saṃkrāntamādarśatale 'pi bimbamanarhamādhāravaśānnijaṃ yat|| 35
yatrābhiṣikte patatāmbhasārdrā vasundharā vāridhicārukāñci| ūrdhvīcakāraikamivātapatraṃ yaśaḥ sphuraccandrakalāvadātam|| 36
svalakṣaṇe lakṣitasarvasampatphalaṃ samākhyāti purovipākam| yasyāśiṣo vipraganaprayuktāḥ kṛtānuvādā iva sambabhūvuḥ|| 37
dvirephamālā iva pārijātaṃ dhiyo munīnāmiva cātmayogam| vyāpāramanyaṃ jagatāṃ vihāya dṛśo dvitīyaṃ pratipedire yam|| 38
itastato vidyudivādyutacchrīstāvannṛpāṇāṃ pracalā prakṛtyā| ramyā śaratprādurabhūnna yāvadyadīyayātrāsamayo nirabhrā|| 39
tīvrāstranīrājanarājitaśrīrdīpto mahāmaṇḍaladīkṣayā yaḥ| vidyāṅgamantraiśca kṛtātmaguptirasādhayatsiddhimudārabhūtim|| 40
yasminvitatya pracalatapaṭākāṃ paṭākinīṃ digvijayāya yāti| dviḍrājalakṣmīḥ pracacāla pūrvamurvī tu paścādbalabhāragurvī|| 41
niśamya saumitrimivābhiyāne 'bhigarjitaṃ nirjitameghanādam| tūryadhvaniṃ yasya daśāsyatulyairdūrāddviṣadbhirvibhayāṃ babhūve|| 42
pratāpavahneriva dhūmajālaṃ baloddhutaṃ yasya rajaḥ prayāṇe| apyaspṛśadvairivilāsinīnāmudaśrayāmāsa vilocanāni|| 43
kṣamāṃ nipīḍya prathamaṃ pravṛttaḥ srotāṃsi kāluṣyamatho rajobhiḥ| yāne nayanyasya samutpapāta saṃghaścamūnāmiva baddharoṣaḥ|| 44
kīrṇaḥ kvacidbhañjitabhūmibhṛdbhiranvāsyamānaḥ paravāhinībhiḥ| kvacicca yasya pratataḥ prayātuḥ svarvāhinīmārga ivāsa mārgaḥ|| 45
viṣvakprasahyāvaraṇāñjanānāṃśceṣṭāsvaśaktiṃ vihataṃ prakāśam| yadyatpradoṣastanute tamobhistattaccakārāripure balairyaḥ|| 46
vitatya pakṣadvayamāttanādaṃ yasminrayāttārkṣya iva prapanne| dviṇnāgavṛndaṃ hatavīryasampadgantavyatāmūḍhatayāvatasthe|| 47
yatraiva saṃvarmayati pragalbhamuttejasi vradhna iva ... | ... yaṃ ca vile vililye ??k/tāpyasīdacca kumudvatīvat|| 48
bāṇāsanaṃ bibhrati yatra yuddhe śuddhe śaratkāla ivābhidṛṣṭe| itastato līnatayāśu moghā meghā ivāsa/llaghavo narendrāḥ|| 49
dadhaddhanuḥ śakradhanurnibhaṃ yo vinadya varṣanniṣuvarṣam... | ... abhimānam|| 50 50450183 śarānmumocāśu harīśvarācale; balāhako vṛṣṭimivācalottame
satyaṃ vimūḍhasya pataṅgasāmyaṃ sametya sānanda ivārivargaḥ| yadbāhudaṇḍāraṇijaṃ jvalantaṃ tejonalaṃ yadvipade 'bhipede|| 51
rayeṇa yena prahito hitorvīruhānnadān... ... ṇānnabhasi pravṛddhaḥ|| 52
nijāsanaṃ prāpya ripūnnirasya ruddhvā marudvartma manorayaṃ ca| vijitya yasyābhyasato 'vatasthe 'pyatīndriye yoga iveṣuvarṣam|| 53
śirāṃsi tejāṃsi samunnatāni dhanaṃ picāyaṃ (?)... bāṇaiḥ samaṃ saṃyati saṃjahāra|| 54
śilīmukhā mūrdhani cāpamuktā jhāṃkāraramyā dviṣatāṃ nipetuḥ| svaḥsundarīhastalatāvimuktamandāragandhānugatāstu yasya|| 55
... yo ... i ... ca nigu... ... tu bandhaṃ cakarta bhūbhṛnnivahottamāṅgam|| 56
śastravraṇāsrasrutidhārayādrau ruddho 'pyarīndrairyudhi yo didīpe| dviṭchāyayācchādita eva bhānurbibhrattanutraṃ tyajati svadīptim|| 57
... ṇe saṃgarasaṃgha... | ... vīryavikīrṇakīrtirdaśānanaṃ durhṛdamunnināya|| 58
na svīcikīrṣuryudhi cakricakraṃ vajraṃ ca no vajrabhṛto 'pi jiṣṇuḥ| yaḥ śaktiyukto nu maheśvarāstraṃ suduḥsahaṃ prāpya jitārivargaḥ|| 59
... hinīṃ vītabhayo nivārya| ... taṃ tvasya vilāsinīnāmabhidyatāraddhṛdayaṃ svayaṃ ca|| 60
yo mathyamānaḥ samare 'rivirairgāmbhīryayogānna jahau prasādam| hrado hi kāluṣyamupaiti bhogātstamberamairambunidhirna jātu|| 61
... caturdiśaṃ pratyurasaṃ bibheti| vididyute vidyudiva sphurantyajihmāpi jihveva bhujoragasya|| 62
snigdhāsipātapratighātahānermuṣṭerlaghutvātsmṛtivibhramādvā| punaḥprahāreṇa kṛte 'ripāte bhujāpavādaṃ bubhuje bhṛśaṃ yaḥ|| 63
... | divyāṅganānāmavatāraṇārthaṃ saupānasampattimivākarodyaḥ|| 64
randhre 'bhiyogaṃ nijapakṣarakṣāṃ vibhajya yo dūṣaṇasādhanābhyām| hṛtottaraprakramamātatāna kurvanpaṭurniṣpratibhaṃ vipakṣam|| 65
... raktatayā phalatvam| 66ab vidhervidheye viparītavṛttervṛttaṃ kṛtī yo 'nucakāra yuddhe|| 66cd
sakhyānunītāpi sadābhimukhye prāgalbhyamicchatyapi śatrusenā| 67ab parāṅmukhī vīkṣya babhūva dūrādvadhūrnavoḍheva samidratau yam|| 67cd
... ḥ śliṣṭe mahājau vijayaśriyā ca| 68ab nāpārthako vikramasampadeti yo yuktamuktaḥ khalu yuktividbhiḥ|| 68cd
durgābhisamparkavivarṇadeho guhānanālocanaloladṛṣṭiḥ| 69ab yasyārisaṃgho mṛgakṛttivāsā vane sthitaḥ sthāṇusamo 'pyanīśaḥ|| 69cd
... varasya manoratho yasya vṛthā babhūva| 70ab norvī yadurvī vijigīṣutāyāṃ vadanyatāyāmapi nālamarthī|| 70cd
preṅkhatprarūḍhasphuṭavidrumaugho hareḥ samākrāntinimagnanāgaḥ| 71ab antarvanairdurgatayābdhitulyo yasyārideśo 'pi jahāti lakṣmīm|| 71cd
... rthasiddhimudyogayuktastrigaṇasya vṛddhyai| 72ab diśaścatasro 'viditaprayāmā jagrāha vidyā iva bālabhāve|| 72cd
kṛtāvakāśaṃ bhuvane vibhutvādaspṛṣṭamanyairguṇibhirmahīyaḥ| 73ab saṃvyaśnute śabdaguṇānubandhaṃ yaśo yadīyaṃ khamivākalaṅkam|| 73cd
... kṣayakarśitāṅgīṃ prāksuśrutācāravicāraṇābhiḥ| 74ab niḥśeṣadoṣakṣapaṇe 'tidakṣo yaḥ ṣaḍrasāṅgairdharaṇīṃ pupoṣa|| 74cd
tadeva tejo vijitānyatejaḥ pūrvaṃ mahanmaṇḍalameva tacca| 75ab bhṛśaṃ didīpe mahadādhipatyaṃ yaḥ prāpya bhāsvāniva madhyamahnaḥ|| 75cd
siṃhāsanādrīndramudīrṇasiṃhaṃ yatrādhirūḍhe sati tīvradhāmni| 76ab na tārakāḥ kevalamastabhāso 'patannṛpāṇāṃ maṇimaulayo 'pi|| 76cd
ekatra śubhre 'pi śaśāṅkaśobhe samuddhṛte yasya mahātapatre| 77ab mahīmaśeṣāṃ pravihāya tāpaḥ samāsasāda dviṣatāṃ manāṃsi|| 77cd
cirāya yadrūpanirūpaṇecchāsaṃcoditā nūnamaśeṣalokāḥ| 78ab makhairasaṃkhyairanimeṣabhūyaṃ bhūyo 'bhyavāñchannijavāñchitāptyai|| 78cd
lakṣmīṃ didṛkṣuḥ sahajāṃ suhṛtsu yathākramaṃ saṃkramayāṃcakāra| 79ab sadarpaṇāṃ yo maṇidarpaṇeṣu cchāyāmiva svāṃ paribhuktabhūṣaḥ|| 79cd
yasyātitejiṣṭhatayāsa nītirnitāntamṛjvī na yathā pareṣām| 80ab muktvārkacandrau na gatirgrahāṇāṃ pratīpavakrānyatamasya kasya|| 80cd
sanmantramūlaiścaturaścaturbhiḥ sāmādibhiryo vividhaprayogaiḥ| 81ab apāyasaṃrodhibhirabhyupāyairvedaiśca saṃsādhayati sma siddhim|| 81cd
sadāpi mūlaprakṛtiḥ pratītaścitraṃ mahatkarma ca darśayanyaḥ| 82ab ṣāḍguṇyayogāttriguṇaṃ pradhānamatulyamācaṣṭa vināpi vācā|| 82cd
prāyeṇa jihmo 'pi vidhirvidheye mantraprabhūtsāhaviśeṣaśaktīḥ| 83ab apāyadṛṣṭeḥ pratikūlapakṣe 'nukūlayāmāsa bhiyeva yasya|| 83cd
trivargasaṃsargasuhṛdbhirārādrāṣṭre guṇaughairavabhartsyamānāḥ| 84ab doṣā ruṣevāśu vipakṣapakṣamaśiśriyanyasya guṇāśrayasya|| 84cd
nirbhidya sadyaḥ svamavadyamudyanyo 'nyāyino 'nyānvinināya yuktyā| 85ab tamāṃsyapi ghnansakalaṃ kalaṅkamupekṣate svaṃ kṣaṇadākaro hi|| 85cd
suśāsanādavyasanācca yasya prajāsu jātā na vipattiśaṅkā| 86ab ajātaśatrorapi rājaputrī duḥśāsanātprāpa parāṃ purārtim|| 86cd
chidrapratīkṣāpragamāttaśīlāḥ sudurdharāḥ khaṇḍitadhāmabhiśca| 87ab yaṃ pārthivaṃ pātramavāpya lakṣmyaḥ stheṣṭhā ivāpaḥ suvidagdhamāsan|| 87cd
yaḥ śaktisiṃhīṃ paritaścarantīṃ vidrāvya hiṃsrāmarivargamārge| 88ab vṛṣeṇa yogāduditaprajāṃ gāṃ pupoṣa lakṣmīṃ mahiṣīmavāpya|| 88cd
ajīgaṇatsūrigaṇo 'tirājñāṃ sahasradoṣaṃ dhuri kārtavīryam| 89ab yadā tadā sarvaguṇairanūne nūnaṃ kathā kā punareva yasmin|| 89cd
divaḥpṛthivyorapi gīyamānaṃ jiṣṇoryaśo 'pyarjitavīryasampat| 90ab karṇāsukhaṃ śrotrasukhasya śa"kne yasyopamārhaṃ yaśaso na jātam|| 90cd
ākrāntadigvyomni payomucīva prāgarjite yasya yaśasyudāttam| 91ab na kevalaṃ ratnamupāyanaṃ drākprādādgajādyaṃ ca vidūrabhūmiḥ|| 91cd
lakṣādhvarotthaiḥ sthagayadbhirāśā dhūmairniruddhārkakarākarairyaḥ| 92ab divaṃ ca śātakratavīṃ ca kīrtiṃ malīmasatvaṃ yugapannināya|| 92cd
yaddhūmasaṃdarśanato 'numānamagnestadevāvyabhicāramuktam| 93ab navaṃ tu yanmakhadhūmadṛṣṭau vṛṣṭervasūnāmanumānameva|| 93cd
svayaṃ prapannābhirayācamānaṃ pūrṇaṃ susampadbhirivādbhirabdhim| 94ab rikto 'pi yaṃ prāpya yatheṣṭapūrṇaḥ punarvavarṣābhra ivārthisārthaḥ|| 94cd
cakṣurmanohāryapi darśayacca karāgraśobhāmapi sadrasārdram| 95ab yasyendubimbaṃ śubharaṅgavṛtternṛttopamārhaṃ na kuraṅgaduṣṭam|| 95cd
chāyāśrito 'pyanyanṛpo vijetuṃ dṛptadviṣo 'laṃ kimuta svayaṃ yaḥ| 96ab āstāṃ raviḥ saṃkramitorutejāścandro na kiṃ santamasānyudasyet|| 96cd
saṃdarśayāmāsa tathānyabhūṣā na bhūriśobhāṃ maṇidarpaṇaṃ ca| 97ab rājñāṃ yathājñā nijakarṇapūrīkṛtāyadīyā nakhadarpaṇaśrīḥ|| 97cd
anyo 'pi sankenacideva tulyo guṇena no yanmahimānamāpa| 98ab nṛttavrato yāti hi nīlakaṇṭhasna tāvataiveśvaratāṃ mayūraḥ|| 98cd
sadāgatiḥ snehakarī vibhutvaṃ bibhratyadabhraṃ dadhatī prakāśam| 99ab pṛthvī yadīyā racanāṃ jagatsu dhatte mahābhūtamayīva kīrtiḥ|| 99cd
vadanyatāśauryavapurvilāsagāmbhīryamādhuryadayādayo ye| 100ab teṣāmivaiko nilayaḥ prayatnadhiyādhiko yo vidadhe vidhātrā|| 100cd
pratītavīryo bhuvi kārtavīryo vīryaṃ yadīyaṃ dvibhujorjitaṃ prāk| 101ab vīkṣeta cedātmabharāya janye manyeta manye svasahasrahastān|| 101cd
dūrātpratāpairdviṣatāṃ vijeturyasya svayuddhaṃ nitarāṃ durāpam| 102ab gandhadvipasyeva madotkaṭasya vitrāsitānyadviradasya gandhaiḥ|| 102cd
vihāya saṅgaṃ paradevatāsu śraddhā ca bhaktiśca parā yadīyā| 103ab śrīkaṇṭhamutkaṇṭhatayā prapanne gaṅgābhavānyāviva devadevam|| 103cd
saundaryasarvamaryādāṃ vidhātā darśayanniva| 104ab jātarūpamayastambhaṃ yamekaṃ bhuvana vyadhāt|| 104cd
itthaṃ kṛto mayā kāmo dagdhaḥ kila pinākinā| 105ab itīveśvaratāṃ nīto vidhātrā yo 'tisundaraḥ|| 105cd
catasṛṣvapi vidyāsu caturaṃ menire prajāḥ| 106ab catuḥṣaṣṭikalāḍhyaṃ yaṃ caturāsyaṃ prajāpatim|| 106cd
lakṣmīṃ vakṣaḥsthale kṣiptvā kīrtiṃ pāre payonidheḥ| 107ab vidyayā kāmato reme vṛddhayaiva yuvāpi yaḥ|| 107cd
jugopa gāṃ vasiṣṭhasya dilīpaḥ prākprajecchayā| 108ab labdhvā prajāḥ svavīryeṇa bhārgavīṃ yastu medinīm|| 108cd
bhuvanāplāvanodvele yatkīrtikṣīrasāgare| 109ab chāyāvyājena bhūrbhītyā nūnamindumupāśritā|| 109cd
sahasrabhogabharito bibhradbhāraṃ bhuvo 'pi yaḥ| 110ab anantaguṇayukto 'pi vinatārtiharo bhṛśam|| 110cd
urvīmāvṛṇvatāmbodhimekhalābhogamaṇḍitām| 111ab ekacchatreṇa mahatā meruryena vṛthā kṛtaḥ|| 111cd
kalikaṇṭakasamparkādāskhalanpadahānitaḥ| 112ab dharmaḥ kṛtāvatārastu yaṃ samālambya susthitaḥ|| 112cd
yasya vīryāniloddhūto dhāmadhūmadhvajo yudhi| 113ab dviḍvadhūnāṃ vidhūmo 'pi bāṣpadhārāmavardhayat|| 113cd
acirābhānibhāriśrīḥ stheyasyāsīdyamāśritā| 114ab guṇānubandhabaddhāpi kīrtiḥ kenāpi digdrutā|| 114cd
rūḍhaḥ śrīnandane yasya raṇe raktāsipallavaḥ| 115ab bāhukalpadrumo dikṣu yaśaḥpuṣpamavākirat|| 115cd
yadyāne dṛptadantīndradantanirghātatāḍitā| 116ab ruṣevorvī mahāsattvānrajasā sāndramāvṛṇot|| 116cd
samididdhe kṛpāṇāgnau mantrasādhanabṛṃhitaḥ| 117ab hutvārivaktrapadmāni yaḥ sāmrājyamajījanat|| 117cd
dṛḍho 'pyadhṛṣyasattvo 'pi tuṅgo 'pyunmūlito ripuḥ| 118ab mathane 'nantavīryeṇa yena bhūbhṛtkulodgataḥ|| 118cd
tṛṣiteva dviṣāṃ lakṣmīḥ pluṣṭā tejogninā bhṛśam| 119ab yasya puṣkarajāṃ dhārāṃ prāpya cikṣepa na kṣaṇam|| 119cd
pādāmbujarajo yasya caritānukṛteriva| 120ab tuṅgabhūbhṛdvarāṅgeṣu padaṃ dattvā śriyaṃ dadhau|| 120cd
nidrāvidrāṇadṛkstrīvajjaṭhareṇāvahatprajāḥ| 121ab hariryastu hṛdaiveśaḥ subodhasphuṭapauruṣaḥ|| 121cd
dṛptārīndraṃ vijityājau yo 'nujagrāha tatkulam| 122ab bhṛṅgaiḥ kiṃ hi madabhrāntairbhinnebhendro mṛgādhipaḥ|| 122cd
nistriṃśaṃ vallabhaṃ baddhvā guṇayuktaistu mārgaṇaiḥ| 123ab ṛjubhiryo vijityārīnbheje 'rthānsadguṇairiva|| 123cd
nipītaṃ nīlakaṇṭhena kaṇṭhālaṃkṛtaye viṣam| 124ab vibudhānāṃ priyārthaṃ tu yenodvāntaṃ vacomṛtam|| 124cd
sāndrairyasyādhvare dhūmairūrdhvagai ruddhadṛṣṭibhiḥ| 125ab bradhno 'dhunāpi digbhrāntaiḥ svadhuryairbhrāmyate dhruvam|| 125cd
saṃdhukṣya dhāmavahniṃ yo dviṭsamidbhiḥ saminmakhe| 126ab akṣīṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kīrtiṃ digdvijebhyaḥ samādiśat|| 126cd
dviṣatāṃ nyastaśastrāṇāṃ praṇāmaśithilīkṛte| 127ab cāpasyaiva guṇe yasya viratirna tu dhanvinām|| 127cd
suvṛtto 'sisuhṛddhṛdyo bhujo yasya mahībhujaḥ| 128ab durhṛdāmasuhṛttve 'pi pratītaḥ sarvadā raṇe|| 128cd
ekadravyāśritaṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā dviḍjñātibhāvitam| 129ab kārmukeṣūcitaṃ karma saviśeṣaṃ vyadhatta yaḥ|| 129cd
śūlinādhyāsitāṃ bhaktigambhīrāṃ yasya hṛdguhām| 130ab tannetrānalabhītyeva viviśurnānyadevatāḥ|| 130cd
rāmāṇāṃ hṛdayārāme tiṣṭhantaṃ kāmataskaram| 131ab prajihīrṣurivāśrānto yo viveśa muhurmuhuḥ|| 131cd
yogodyato 'pi yaḥ śāntau nāmnaiva dviḍbhayaṃkaraḥ| 132ab dūrāddhi rājasiṃhasya gandhaṃ ghrātvā dvipā drutāḥ|| 132cd
mantravīryaprayogāḍhyaṃ prāpyānanyavareva yam| 133ab kṛtārthā kāmadā pṛthvī karajāmardamārdavāt|| 133cd
yuktiretāvatā tyaktā kāntiratne 'pi darśite| 134ab yajjagaccittasarvasvamāhṛtaṃ yena sarvadā|| 134cd
nyastaśastro vane supto hariryogaparo 'pyajaḥ| 135ab kāntārdhāṅgadharo rudro yaṃ jgīiṣuṃ smaranniva|| 135cd
sphuṭāsīndīvarasrastaraktamadhvāsavecchayā| 136ab dviṭchrīrbhṛṅgīva babhrāma yasya dorhradasannidhau|| 136cd
nakṣatrakulasampannaṃ bhūtānāmavakāśakṛt| 137ab vyomevāripuraṃ yasya śabdamātreṇa lakṣitam|| 137cd
śarākarṣākulo yasya vāhinīdurgasaṃgataḥ| 138ab vane khaḍgasahāyo 'riḥ saṃyatsaṃstha iva drutaḥ|| 138cd
vairiṇo dhyānaniratā vītarāgā guhāśayāḥ| 139ab yasyeśasyāṅghriyogena vinā nālaṃ vimuktaye|| 139cd
kāhaṃ bhartrā parityaktā śvāpadaiḥ sthātumutsahe| 140ab itīvāripurī yasya prāviśaddāvapāvakam|| 140cd
yasya sattvavato vīryaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā dviṣadgaṇaḥ| 141ab sattvepsayeva siṃhādiyuktamanvavasadvanam|| 141cd
madonmatto 'pi tuṅgo 'pi niyojyo dharmasādhane| 142ab itībhendragaṇo yena dvijebhyo 'dāyi bhūriśaḥ|| 142cd
vibhaktiṃ prakṛtīnāṃ yaḥ saptadhā vidadhatpade| 143ab taddhitārthaparaścāsīdāgamākhyātakṛtyavit|| 143cd
pratāpānalasaṃtaptā śaṅke dāhābhiśaṅkayā| 144ab āplāvitāsakṛddhātrī yena dānāmbuvṛṣṭibhiḥ|| 144cd
sumanohāriṇī yasya guṇairbaddhā vikāsinī| 145ab lokatrayaśriyādyāpi kīrtimālā dhṛtādhikam|| 145cd
yasya sāgaragambhīraparikhā bhasmasātkṛtā| 146cd campādhirājanagarī vīrairājñānukāribhiḥ|| 146cd
vivarṇau caraṇau yasya nṛpamaulimaṇitviṣā| 147ab sarvavarṇānuraktā tu nirmalorvī bhujoddhṛtā|| 147cd
kalirekāntavāmo 'pi dakṣiṇo yasya śāsane| 148ab drutārīnanududrāva tejonalabhayādiva|| 148cd
tathā nīranidheryena kṣoṇī niṣkaṇṭakīkṛtā| 149ab nādyāpi skhalitā kīrtiryathaikā sarvato gata|| 149cd
guṇeṣu mukhyayā vṛttyā gauṇyā dravyeṣvavartata| 150ab gaṇanāpi mataṃ yasya kāśyapīyamanujjhataḥ|| 150cd
yathākāmaṃ dviṣatkāmaḥ kva nililye nu nirbhayam| 151ab yadyasya yāne dhūlībhiḥ sāndhakārīkṛtā diśaḥ|| 151cd
prādhvaṃkṛtā sadā premṇā vidagdhadhiyamutsukā| 152ab na nirāsthata yaṃ jātu rājavidyā kulāṅganā|| 152cd
sākṣātprajāpatirdakṣo dakṣiṇaṃ kṣaṇamakṣiṇoti| 153ab sakalaṃ sakalaṅkaṃ yaḥ kalidoṣākaraṃ kṛtī|| 153cd
sadākṛte makhaśate yastatairdhūmanīradaiḥ| 154ab śaradyapi nabhaścakre prāvṛṣīva malīmasam|| 154cd
parastrīvimukho yo 'pi sadācāravicakṣaṇaḥ| 155ab kenāpyājau paraśrīṇāṃ pāṇigrahavidhiṃ vyadhāt|| 155cd
yasyenasyānyatejāṃsi tejasā jayatodaye| 156ab nūnamaurvānalo 'dyāpi līno 'spardhitayāmbudhau|| 156cd
baddhā vidhātrāhīndreṇa riktā nūnamiyaṃ dharā| 157ab yena svakīrtiratnena pūrayitvā vṛṣāṅkitā|| 157cd
bhinnebhakumbhanirmuktā muktā yena raṇāṅgane| 158ab rejire vidhavāriśrībāṣpāṇāmiva bindavaḥ|| 158cd
kīrtinādāmbudadhvāna... yaddānavṛṣṭayaḥ| 159ab uptaṃ tribhuvanakṣetre dharmabījamavardhayan|| 159cd
siṃho nu nopamānārho yasya śauryeṇa saṃyuge| 160ab tathā hi yadbhiyārātiradhyaśeta guhāṃ hareḥ|| 160cd
vāṇī rājīivarājāṃśurā... | 161ab rojāni niryānti mukhamaṇḍalāt|| 161cd
... pār?ā sutejonalasaṃgatā| 162ab kaliṃ nyakkurvatī yasya rājyaśrīrdamayantyabhūt|| 162cd
yaśovistārasaṃkṣiptā kṣitiryasya ... | 163ab ... r?āṃy... cikīrṣayā|| 163cd
... yamekamatitejasam| 164ab nūnamullekhitastvaṣṭrā bhramamāropya bhāskaraḥ|| 164cd
yogyaṃ varaṃ yamāsādya martyaloke sarasvatī| 165ab śāpaṃ durvāsasastīvraṃ manye mene 'pyanugraham|| 165cd
tārayitrī titīrṣūṇāṃ gambhīrāpanmahānadīm| 166ab vedavyāsaṃ na suṣuve yasya vāksatyavatyapi|| 166cd
ṛjavo guṇasamparkādāpadāṃ pratighātinaḥ| 167ab iṣubhyo na vyaśiṣyanta yasyopāyā bṛhatphalāḥ|| 167cd
jīrṇāhīndreṇa vidhṛtā sācaleyaṃ calediti| 168ab yūni nūnaṃ nyadhādvedhā yatrāhīne vasundharām|| 168cd
vibhūtirbhūtapūrvāpi rājñāṃ ca guṇasaṃhatiḥ| 169ab sauṣṭhavaudāryabhedena yadupajñamivābhavat|| 169cd
sambhṛtāḥ kṣmābhṛtāṃ lakṣmīrā bālyātkanyakā iva| 170ab yathākālamupāyairyo nirapāyairupāyata|| 170cd
śabdaśāstre 'pyadhītī yo vinā dvirvacanaṃ guroḥ| 171ab kenāpyabhyastakāryeṣu yuktakārītyudīritaḥ|| 171cd
yasyopamānaṃ saṃjātaṃ na kiṃcidguṇavistaraiḥ| 172ab buddhvā bauddhaṃ mataṃ mene 'nyatīrthairapi nānyathā|| 172cd
kāladoṣāmbudhau magnā durge gambhīrabhīṣaṇe| 173ab prāpya pāramivottuṅgaṃ yaṃ samāśvasiṣuḥ prajāḥ|| 173cd
śubhaṃ śubhaṃyunā yūnā manuvartmānuvartinā| 174ab rasāyanaṃ vinābhāvi yena varṣīyasājaram|| 174cd
viṣvagvikīrṇairyugapadyasya tejobhirujjvalaiḥ| 175ab ... cikṣipire chāyāḥ śākhināṃ bhūbhṛtāmapi|| 175cd
rājñāṃ kṛtyamiti jñātvā yasya durgasamāśrayaḥ| 176ab na dānavabhayādabdhimadhiśete ripurmadhoḥ|| 176cd
api kāmādayo doṣāḥ sthāne yena niyojitāḥ| 177ab guṇīkṛtāḥ svabhāvena guṇānmā sma punarvadat|| 177cd
manīṣibhirmanohatya pivadbhiścaritāmṛtam| 178ab atipānādivodgīrṇaṃ yasya kāvyairnijaiḥ saha|| 178cd
doṣāndhakārabahalaṃ jagajjātaṃ yathā yathā| 179ab yasya dīpā iva guṇāḥ prādurbhūtāstathā tathā|| 179cd
dharmeṇa saṃskṛtānāṃ yo niṣidhya jagatāmapi| 180ab vināśahetuṃ nātasthe kṣaṇabhaṅgaprasaṅgitām|| 180cd
anekakraturapyuccaiḥpado gopatirapyagāt| 181ab akrodhanasya yasyendraḥ ... || 181cd
bhṛgumātramapi prāpya vahneḥ pratihataṃ purā| 182ab tejastvadhākṣīdyasyāpi mahāntaṃ vāhinīpatim|| 182cd
vadanyaḥ svaśriyaṃ cakre suhṛtsādhāraṇīṃ harim| 183ab vakṣonikṣiptalakṣmī... || 183cd
tarṣo harṣeṇa samprāpya vyanīyata vanīpakaiḥ| 184ab yaṃ mahāntaṃ hradamiva prasannaṃ sphuṭapuṣkaram|| 184cd
asūryaṃpaśyamasuhṛtstrīvaktrakumudākaram| 185ab uccaiḥ saṃkocayāmāsa ... || 185cd
patacchilīmukhacchāyacchannadviḍvadanāmbuje| 186ab rarāja rājahaṃso yaścaranraṇamahāhrade|| 186cd
saṃmukhīno raṇamukhe yasya nāsīdasīdataḥ| 187ab preṅkhatsvakhaḍgasaṃkrāntaṃ pra... || 187cd
dhanurdarśanamātreṇa tīrthadhvāṅkṣā dviṣo drutāḥ| 188ab kāmaṃ puro na yasyājau bhujaṅgārirapi sthitaḥ|| 188cd
sālakānanaramyāṃ yaḥ sphuṭapuṣpaśilīmukham| 189ab drutebhyaḥ padavīṃ dvidbhyo yoddhṛbhyaḥ ... || 189cd
prollasatkīcakaśatā kaṅkādibhirupāśritā| 190ab śūnyāpyaripurī yena virāṭanagarī kṛtā|| 190cd
kevalaṃ rājanāgānāṃ vīryaṃ mantra ivāharat| 191ab yo nādyūnatayā prāṇānkṣipaṃstārkṣya ivakṣitau|| 191cd
dṛṣṭvā yasyādhvaraṃ śakrayaśovibhraṃśaśaṅkayā| 192ab dhūmasparśacchalānnūnamudaśrunayanā śacī|| 192cd
ruddhānyatejaso yasya pādacchāyāmaśiśriyan| 193ab merorivelāpatayaḥ sitacchatratyajo 'niśam|| 193cd
sṛṣṭau candrārkayordhātānādarādiva bhinnayoḥ| 194ab yamekaṃ tapanāhlādasamarthamasamaṃ vyadhāt|| 194cd
upāntasevāṃ vāñchantyo yatpādaṃ tīvratejasam| 195ab mauliratnaprabhāmbhobhirasiñcanbhūpapaṅktayaḥ|| 195cd
navaṃ priyamaho loke yadvihāya dhanuḥ smaraḥ| 196ab unmamāthāṅganācittaṃ yatkāntyānupamānayā|| 196cd
sphuṭāṣṭadikprāntadala hemaśailorukarṇike| 197ab yaśo gandhāyate yasya bhuvanaikasaroruhe|| 197cd
udvāntarāgāḥ sphuritā yasyāṅghrinakharaśmayaḥ| 198ab aspardhanta natorvīndramauliratnamarīcibhiḥ|| 198cd
anvarudhyata yasyājñāṃ phalaprasavasampade| 199ab ājanmavandhyaścūto 'pi vasiṣṭhasya dilīpavat|| 199cd
sahasramukhasaṃkīrtyaṃ gambhīraṃ guṇavistaram| 200ab yasya bhāṣyamiva prāpya vyākhyā khinnāpi dhīmatām|| 200cd
śrīmatsiddheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ siddhaṃ śivapure girau| 201ab vardhayāmāsa yo bhogairapūrvaiḥ śivikādibhiḥ|| 201cd
tatrāpi liṅgaṃ sarvasya śarvāṇīpratime śubhe| 202ab yaḥ samyaksthāpayāmāsa pitṝṇAṃ dharmavṛddhaye|| 202cd
yadupakramamāseva śrībhadreśvaraśūlinaḥ| 203ab bhogo 'nyatrāpi devānyaḥ pūjābhirudamīmilat|| 203cd
vivṛddhiṃ dharmasindhūnāṃ śrīndravarmādibhūbhṛtām| 204ab svamaṇḍalasya ca samaṃ yaścakre nṛpacandramāḥ|| 204cd
yaśodharataṭākasya dakṣiṇenāpi dakṣiṇaḥ| 205ab yaḥ śaurigaurīśanimāḥ śambhorliṅgamatiṣṭhipat|| 205cd
sa somavaṃśāmbarabhāskaraḥ śrīrājendravarmā tadidaṃ nṛpendraḥ| 206ab svargāpavargādhigamasya liṅgaṃ liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpitavānsmarāreḥ|| 206cd
samprāptayoḥ prāptayaśāḥ svapitrorbhuvaḥ patiḥ so 'pi bhavodbhavena| 207ab sasthānatāṃ sthāpitavānsthitijño nime ime dve śivayoḥ śivāya|| 207cd
mahābhujaḥ so 'pi caturbhujasya nimāmimāmambujajanmanaśca| 208ab atiṣṭhipanniṣṭhitarājakṛtyo liṅgānyathāṣṭāvapyaṣṭamūrteḥ|| 208cd
ratnollasadbhogasahasradīptaṃ sa cāpyahīnaṃ draviṇasya rāśim| 209ab aśeṣamapyeṣvaditeva śeṣaṃ deveṣu devendrasamānavīryaḥ|| 209cd
sa kalpayāmāsa mahendrakalpaḥ sadā sadācāravidhiṃ vidheyam| 210ab śaivaśrutismṛtyuditāṃ saparyāṃ paryāptamāsāmiha devatānām|| 210cd
sa cāpi vācaspatidhīḥ sadhīraṃ dharmānugaṃ dharmadharabhṛtāṃ purogaḥ| 211ab tānbhāvino bhāvitarājadharmānidaṃ vaco 'vocata kambujendrān|| 211cd
rakṣyasya saṃrakṣaṇaṃ ... yatsa kṣatradharmo vidhito yadā vaḥ| 212ab puṇyaṃ tadetatparirakṣateti vijñāpanā sādhayatīva siddham|| 212cd
dharmo yuge 'sminsthiramekapātsa kathaṃ samasthāsyata susthito 'yam| 213abhavādṛśāṃ śāstradṛśāṃ sa no cenmahābhujastambhamupāśrayiṣyat|| 213cd
dharmāpadaḥ sādhu... ko 'pi lajjeta kartā kimuta svayaṃ ca| 214ab rakṣādhikārī nṛpatirviśeṣāditi pratītaṃ bhavatāmidaṃ tat|| 214cd
santo yaśodharmadhanā na bāhyaṃ dhanaṃ dhanāyeyurihātmano 'pi| 215ab prāgeva devādidhanaṃ satāṃ vo viniścayo 'yaṃ nanu baddhamūlaḥ|| 215cd
tathāpi bhūyaḥ kathayāmi yuṣmāṃstadakṣataṃ rakṣata puṇyametat| 216ab mā hārṣṭa devasvamiti prakāśaṃ na dharmahetoḥ punaruktadoṣaḥ|| 216cd
abhyarthito 'sūnapi samprayacchenmahānmahimnā kimuta svakṛtyam| 217ab ataśca visrambhabalapragalbhā vākprārthanābhaṅgabhayojjhitaiṣā|| 217cd
śākābde gaṇyamāne kṛtanagavasubhirmāghamāsasya puṇye śuklasyaikādaśāhe 'nimiṣamapi bhave yāti varṣārdhamindau| 218ab arcābhiḥ śaurigaurīgiriśakajabhuvāṃ sārdhamardhendumauleḥ śrīrājendreśvarākhyaṃ sthitimakṛta parāṃ liṅgamatredamābhiḥ|| 218cd
